derivation: hand-derived from canonical-encoding.md §7 prose alone, before any implementation exists

construction.hash: SHA-256 via ProtocolHash(domain, payload) = SHA-256(u8(len(domain)) || domain || payload)
construction.bit_order: bit(i) is the (i mod 8)-th most significant bit of byte i // 8; the path from root to leaf consumes bit(0) first and bit(255) last; 0 selects left

checks.name: empty-domain-root
checks.purpose: an empty domain's root is empty[256], the derived empty commitment at the root level

checks.name: single-leaf
checks.purpose: leaf preimage is tag || key || record bytes; every sibling on the path is the level's empty commitment

checks.name: divergence-bit-0
checks.purpose: left/right ordering by bit; also the bit-order boundary where two keys differ only in the MSB of byte 0

checks.name: divergence-bit-255
checks.purpose: full-depth path with no early collapse; also the bit-order boundary where two keys differ only in the LSB of byte 31

checks.name: same-record-different-keys
checks.purpose: the key is committed into the leaf: two subjects with identical (empty) record bytes have different leaves

checks.name: same-key-record-different-tags
checks.purpose: the domain tag is committed into the leaf; a leaf-construction check, so the record's validity under the other tag is irrelevant

checks.name: leaf-node-domain-separation
checks.purpose: the same 64-byte payload hashes differently under the leaf and node domains; note a valid leaf preimage is 1 + 32 + len(record) bytes, so a shape collision with a node preimage would need a 31-byte record and no record type is 31 bytes

checks.name: absence-unoccupied-key
checks.purpose: an absent key's level-0 slot holds empty[0]; the domain root is unchanged from the occupied-only tree

checks.name: absence-adjacent-key
checks.purpose: absence needs no adjacency reasoning under fixed depth: the path for a key differing only in bit(255) has the same shape

checks.name: malformed-record-trailing-byte
checks.purpose: record bytes that fail strict exact-consume decoding

checks.name: invalid-domain-root-mismatch
checks.purpose: a well-formed proof whose recomputed root differs from the claimed domain root

checks.name: world-commitment
checks.purpose: WorldCommitmentV1 is a canonical record of four named ordered roots; world_root is its protocol hash
checks.conservation: one blockmon, created = 1, so extant == created holds

checks.name: invalid-wrong-commitment-position
checks.purpose: a domain root presented at a position other than its assigned one yields a different world_root

checks.name: supply-singleton
checks.purpose: the supply domain's only admissible key is 32 zero bytes; supply_commitment is this root

checks.name: malformed-supply-key
checks.purpose: a supply key other than 32 zero bytes
